name: Washington 1889
designer: Unidentified in the consulted historical specimen
description: Broad high-contrast display letters with triangular entry serifs and a lively historical lowercase.
observed: The 1889 Boston page anchors the face. Central/Boston 1892 and ATF 1896/1898 supply larger 4579VWbghkmpuwy impressions. The complete Washington alphabets in the 1897 GPO Job Division specimen, p. 49, establish JQZjq and replace the smaller f/v/z reconstructions. All A–Z and a–z now have located historical impressions. Exact crops and measured baselines distinguish source forms from digital weight harmonisation.
reconstructed: The small observed zero remains redrawn. Punctuation and remaining symbols are project drawings. Spacing and weight harmonisation are digital work; h/k/m/w and Z/j/z have wider advances to fit their observed outlines. J/Q/Z/j/q use actual Washington impressions, including the crossing Q tail and curled j descender. The 1889 suffix dates the principal source, not a claim of first release.

sources.title: Specimen book from the Boston type foundry (1889), Washington; printed p. 184, one-based PDF page 190, Internet Archive leaf 190
sources.rights: 1889 US publication, public domain under the maximum historical 95-year term. Library of Congress scan hosted by Internet Archive; retained institutional metadata says the Library is unaware of copyright restrictions. Original native JP2 leaf; no modern digital typeface used.

sources.rights: 1892 US publication, public domain by age; the archive record marks this scan Public Domain Mark 1.0. University of Michigan copy digitized by Google, distributed through HathiTrust and assembled by David M. MacMillan / Circuitous Root. No modern digital font used.

sources.title: American Type Founders Collective Specimen Book (1895/1896), Washington Series, printed p. 460
sources.rights: Original 1895/1896 US specimen material is public domain, expressly identified as such by scan provider David M. MacMillan / Circuitous Root. This is a lossless crop of the historical page image extracted from the scan of the Garland facsimile; modern introductions and commentary are excluded.

revival.author: Harold Lehmann
revival.notes: The canonical master and glyph overrides retain the complete 104-character encoding. Original and supplemental row records document the historical impressions. prepare_revisions.py and weight-refinement.json reproduce source tracing and display-weight corrections. JQZfjqvz are measured from the 1897 full alphabet page. Advances expand only when required by the observed outline; source and before/after proofs show the resulting forms.
